cases.text:
# Paper-trading risk limits. Changed only by the owner; the engine only reads this file (every
# minute of event time). An invalid file makes the engine open nothing.
size_sol: 0.5              # per trade (addendum §6: 0.5-1 SOL of 10 SOL capital)
max_open_positions: 5
max_exposure_sol: 2.5      # sum of open positions at entry cost
daily_loss_limit_sol: 1.0  # realized loss per UTC day; beyond it no new positions that day
kill_switch: false         # true: open nothing
families: [F7]
pool_cooldown_h: 24        # no new entry in a pool for 24 h after a total loss there (pre-registration risk rules)
